19980.ins: Plush Christmas pieces want a lint roller between wears rather than a wash, and the ears headband keeps its shape folded into a decoration box for the eleven months off-duty. Pink and red run the same construction, so the choice is purely mood.
19980.short: Plush Christmas bunny set with rabbit ears, neck ring, top and thong in pink or red, four pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

19994.ins: Printed measurements by size - bust and waist for each of M, L, and XL - make this the bunny listing to order by tape measure rather than optimism. The headband arrives with the jumpsuit, so the two-tone black set is complete in one bag.
19994.short: Black one-piece bunny uniform with headband in M, L and XL, each size printed with bust 76-130 cm and waist 60-100 cm ranges.

19999.ins: Five pieces with the bracelet filling the wrist gap the back cutout opens in the silhouette - it is the accessory that makes the set read finished from behind, which matters in exactly the setting this set is worn in.
19999.short: Lace-mesh maid set with back cutout, headband, neck ring, dress, thong and bracelet, five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

20005.ins: Two pieces and chiffon is the definition of an at-home costume: nothing structural, nothing to assemble, machine-gentle in a bag and dry by morning. The headdress is the only piece that marks it as costume, and it comes off in one motion.
20005.short: Two-piece at-home maid costume in soft chiffon with dress and headdress, one size for 40-60 kg, home-wear role-play set.

20013.ins: Lace as the base fabric for an ancient-Chinese dancer costume is the unconventional choice - satin dominates the genre - and it trades stage shine for skin visibility, which is the register this listing lives in. Full-set arrival means every panel matches.
20013.short: Red lace ancient Chinese dancer costume sold as a full set with flowing stage styling, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

20044.ins: Three-point construction is self-explanatory once seen: headgear and bracelet carry the costume, bra and thong are the outfit. Chiffon in as-pictured colorway keeps everything light, and the whole set stores in the space of a folded shirt.
20044.short: Three-point chiffon maid outfit with headgear, bracelet, bra and thong, one size for 40-60 kg, minimal coverage costume as pictured.

20050.ins: Silver and pink laser-finish leather shift tone as light moves across them - flat photographs undersell the effect, which is worth knowing if the costume is being chosen for a party rather than a screen. Three sizes up to XL for 60-70 kg.
20050.short: Laser leather bunny one-piece with headwear in silver or pink, three sizes M to XL up to 60-70 kg, color-shifting finish.

20052.ins: OL and teacher share a silhouette - fitted top, straight skirt - and this set plays both without committing to either prop. Add glasses for the teacher read, a folder for the office one, or nothing at all for a costume that needs no explanation.
20052.short: Chiffon OL teacher uniform set with top and skirt, one size for 40-60 kg, office-lady two-piece role-play costume as pictured.

20060.ins: White is the rarer colorway for the school swimsuit reference - navy is the default - and it changes the read from uniform-adjacent to costume-forward. Polyester swimsuit fabric means actual water tolerance, not just the suggestion of it.
20060.short: White polyester Japanese school one-piece swimsuit with authentic fitted cut, one size for 40-60 kg, campus costume reference.

20067.ins: The pants-format sailor one-piece is the answer to skirt management on a night that involves sitting, stairs, or cars. Bust 70-120 cm and waist 60-90 cm are printed, which settles the size question before the order rather than after.
20067.short: Sheer white sailor one-piece with pants, bust 70-120 cm and waist 60-90 cm, one size for 40-60 kg, uniform-to-lingerie crossover.
